summary: Enhance your skills with our M&E for HIV/AIDS Projects Training Course. Learn effective monitoring and evaluation techniques to improve project outcomes.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation for HIV/AIDS projects helps teams track interventions and treatment outcomes with structured, reliable data. Designed for public health professionals managing HIV program information, the training covers developing a Theory of Change and logical framework, assessing data quality, analyzing the care cascade and viral-load outcomes, and building dashboards for reporting.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is structured for professionals responsible for designing, implementing, and managing data systems within HIV/AIDS interventions. It targets individuals who must ensure data integrity and donor compliance across the health sector.
modules: Foundations of HIV/AIDS M&E and Global Frameworks
Designing the M&E System: Theory of Change and LogFrames
Core HIV/AIDS Indicators and Donor Reporting
Data Collection Systems and Digital Health Integration
Data Quality Assurance (DQA) in Health Systems
Analyzing the HIV Care Cascade and Treatment Outcomes
Strategic Reporting, Evaluation, and Adaptive Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic public health data collection and familiarity with Microsoft Excel. No advanced coding or prior DHIS2 administration experience is required. Participants must bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel and Power BI Desktop installed to participate in the data visualization and cascade analysis exercises.
